environment_notes: An initial sandboxed full-suite run passed 879 of 891 tests.
Eleven failures were localhost bind EPERM errors and one was a default-home event-log EPERM error.
The full suite passed outside those sandbox restrictions with an explicit temporary event-log path.

independent_review.caveat: The explicit --capture-baseline mode bypasses digest enforcement and is not a conformance run.

nonclaims: This is not full A2A protocol conformance.
This does not prove compatibility with Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity, Grok, MiniMax, or generic MCP clients.
This does not exercise provider-capable tools, remote delivery, authentication, execution, or production activation.
Child isolation does not claim operating-system network blocking.
